Fall Out Boy actively and perceptibly contributes to a musical performance by singing (including audible lead or backing vocals), rapping, playing a musical instrument, DJ-ing, or conducting a live band; AND

A full solo performance of one or more songs.

A collaborative or joint performance in which Fall Out Boy is physically present and actively contributes musically.

A guest appearance during another artist's set in which Fall Out Boy performs at least one full verse, chorus, or musical segment.

A medley in which Fall Out Boy is present and actively performing, even if Fall Out Boy's portion is partial.

A performance in which Fall Out Boy performs entirely via an officially produced and sanctioned satellite feed, video link, or holographic display that is presented as part of the official live event program, provided that the performance is real-time or was produced specifically for and presented exclusively within the 2027 Pro Football Championship Halftime Show scheduled for Sunday, February 14, 2027.

A performance that begins within the official event timeframe but extends beyond it due to scheduling overrun, provided the performance commenced during the official timeframe.
